routes.note: @http.route() override (no args) of pos_online_payment.PaymentPortal.pos_order_pay -- wraps the parent route to fire a 'progress' bus status before rendering the pay form.
@http.route() override of pos_online_payment.PaymentPortal.pos_order_pay_confirmation -- after the parent settles the tx, fires a 'fail' bus status if the tx did not reach authorized/done.

security.note: No own security: reuses pos_online_payment's public auth='public' + access_token (_check_order_access / _document_check_access) gating on the pay routes, and pos_self_order's anonymous-to-POS-user impersonation; the only new field on a stored model (pos.config.self_order_online_payment_method_id) is reachable through existing POS config ACLs.

views.note: 1 inherited view (views/res_config_settings_views.xml, 36 xml_loc): adds the 'Online Payment' method selector under the self-order 'pay-after' settings block, visible only when self_ordering_mode=='mobile', plus a shortcut button to Payment Methods. No new standalone views.

behavioral_notes.observation: The module subclasses pos_online_payment.PaymentPortal and re-decorates its two public HTTP routes with bare @http.route() (inheriting path/auth from the parent, so /pos/pay/<id> and /pos/pay/confirmation/<id> stay auth='public'). pos_order_pay calls self._send_notification_payment_status(pos_order_id, 'progress') BEFORE super() so the self-order client shows a 'payment in progress' state the instant the customer opens the pay page. pos_order_pay_confirmation calls super() first (which does the real settlement) then re-reads the payment.transaction; if its state is not in ('authorized','done') it fires status 'fail'. _send_notification_payment_status sudo-browses the pos.order, calls pos_order._send_notification_online_payment_status(status) (the bus push) and, on 'success', also pos_order._send_order() (the kitchen/prep-display hook). This thin route-wrapping that turns the synchronous portal confirmation into real-time self-order feedback is pure Python and not in metadata.

_process_pos_online_payment is overridden to add self-order behaviour AROUND the parent settlement (the parent _create_payment's account.payment, calls pos_order.add_payment to write the online pos.payment line linked via online_account_payment_id, and finalises a draft order via _process_saved_order). This override snapshots each tx's pos_order_id.state BEFORE super(); after super(), for txs now in authorized/done it (a) if the order WAS draft, calls pos_order_id._send_self_order_receipt() to email the customer their receipt via the preset mail template, and (b) always calls pos_order_id._send_notification_online_payment_status('success') so the self-order/kiosk client live-confirms. Separately, _process is overridden so that as soon as a self-order/kiosk transaction is confirmed (_is_self_order_payment_confirmed: pos_order_id set, state in authorized/done, source in ('mobile','kiosk')) it triggers the payment.cron_post_process_payment_tx cron immediately -- forcing prompt async post-processing instead of waiting for the scheduler. These settlement-feedback side-effects (receipt email + bus + cron kick) are invisible to field metadata.

pos.order gains a stored computed Boolean use_self_order_online_payment (= bool(config_id.self_order_online_payment_method_id)), also stamped at create() from the session's config and guarded in write() (it is system-managed: writes to it are only honoured for draft orders whose config still has a self-order online method, otherwise silently dropped via filtered_domain rather than raising). _compute_online_payment_method_id is overridden so that when use_self_order_online_payment is true the order's online_payment_method_id resolves to config_id.self_order_online_payment_method_id (the self-order method) instead of the cashier method from super(); this is what makes the portal _get_allowed_providers_sudo offer the self-order providers. get_and_set_online_payments_data (the cashier-frontend RPC) is wrapped so that requesting next_online_payment_amount=0 (cancelling a cashier online tender) flips use_self_order_online_payment back on if a self-order method is configured -- i.e. it falls back to the self-order pay flow. This routing of WHICH online method a self-order uses is pure Python.

_send_notification_online_payment_status(status) is the bus primitive: it calls config_id._notify('ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS', {status, data}) where data carries the order and its pos.payment lines read with _load_pos_self_data_fields (extended here to add online_payment_method_id + next_online_payment_amount) so the self-order client can reconcile the paid order without a full reload; status is one of progress/success/fail. get_order_to_print takes a Postgres row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT) and refuses to print twice (raises if nb_print>0), guaranteeing the kiosk/mobile receipt prints exactly once across concurrent bus listeners. _check_pos_order (the self-order intake sanitiser from pos_self_order) is extended to propagate use_self_order_online_payment from the submitted order dict. These concurrency-safe, data-minimised feedback mechanics are not reverse-engineerable from metadata.

pos.config.self_order_online_payment_method_id (Many2one pos.payment.method, domain is_online_payment=True) designates the online method customers use in mobile self-order; a @api.constrains rejects it for mobile+pay-each configs unless its provider supports the config currency (_get_online_payment_providers(error_if_invalid=True)). pos.payment.method._load_pos_self_data_domain is overridden so the self-order CLIENT only receives the right online methods: in kiosk mode it OR-adds all is_online_payment methods on the config; otherwise it ships exactly the one self_order_online_payment_method_id. has_valid_self_payment_method is extended so a mobile config counts as payable if it has a self-order online method (and any config if any of its methods is_online_payment). _load_pos_self_data_fields(pos.config) is extended to publish self_order_online_payment_method_id to the public self-order app. (Note: this module also defines _get_self_ordering_data/_get_self_ordering_payment_methods_data overrides, but those names have no parent in the current pos_self_order codebase -- the live payment-method exposure runs through the _load_pos_self_data_* family above.) This config-driven channel gating is pure Python.

4 JS files / 1 XML template, no new OWL components or registry services -- only 4 prototype patches across two bundles. In the customer self-order SPA (pos_self_order.assets): SelfOrder.setup opens a connectWebSocket('ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS') listener that, for the current order's uuid, merges the pushed pos.order/pos.payment via models.connectNewData, sets onlinePaymentStatus/paymentError, and on 'success' routes to the confirmation page; getOnlinePaymentUrl builds the /pos/pay/<id>?access_token=...&exit_route=... URL (with table_identifier for table service); filterPaymentMethods surfaces the is_online_payment method(s) (the configured one, or all in kiosk); PaymentPage.startPayment, for an online method, first sendDraftOrderToServer() then in kiosk shows a scan-to-pay QR (generateQRCodeDataUrl) while in mobile window.open's the pay URL in _self; payment_page.xml adds the kiosk 'Scan the QR code to pay' panel; OrderDisplay.buttonToShow relabels the action button (Order/Pay/Pay at cashier) per mode. In the cashier app (point_of_sale._assets_pos): PosStore.setup, for mobile configs, listens to the SAME bus channel and on 'success' prints the self-order prep+receipt (printSelfOrderReceipt -> getSelfOrderToPrint -> get_order_to_print), queuing it while the tab is hidden (visibilitychange). This entire client-side request/QR/await-confirmation/auto-print journey is not reverse-engineerable from Python metadata. integrations_gap7.uses_api_keys=true is indirect: the acquirer credentials live in the underlying payment/payment_<provider> modules, not here.

it_architecture.application: pos_online_payment_self_order (auto-install double-bridge: lets a self-order/kiosk customer pay their pos.order online and reconciles the confirmed transaction back into the live POS session with real-time bus feedback and auto-receipt)
software_services: /pos/pay/<pos_order_id> (override: fire 'progress' bus status, then the inherited public pay form)
/pos/pay/confirmation/<pos_order_id> (override: inherited settlement, then fire 'fail' status if tx not authorized/done)
logical_data_erm: pos.order -> pos.payment.method (online_payment_method_id, re-pointed to the self-order method when use_self_order_online_payment)
pos.payment -> account.payment (online_account_payment_id; written by the inherited add_payment on settlement)
information_flows: depends: pos_online_payment (public /pos/pay portal + transaction->pos.payment settlement + account.payment), pos_self_order (the public OWL self-order/kiosk SPA, pos.order.source mobile/kiosk, the config._notify bus, preset receipt mail)

inbound: self-order client startPayment -> sendDraftOrderToServer -> window.open or QR to /pos/pay/<id> (public) -> parent jsonrpc /pos/pay/transaction creates payment.transaction(pos_order_id=...) -> provider redirect/inline/token

settlement: tx authorized|done -> _process_pos_online_payment(super: account.payment + online pos.payment + finalise draft order) -> _send_self_order_receipt (email, if order was draft) + _send_notification_online_payment_status('success')

bus: config._notify('ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS', {status, pos.order, pos.payment}) -> self-order SPA confirms + cashier PosStore (mobile) auto-prints the prep/receipt once (FOR UPDATE NOWAIT, nb_print guard)

method routing: use_self_order_online_payment -> _compute_online_payment_method_id resolves online_payment_method_id = config.self_order_online_payment_method_id, which the portal uses to pick compatible providers
cron kick: _process -> for confirmed mobile/kiosk tx, _trigger payment.cron_post_process_payment_tx for prompt async finalisation
frontend_components: SelfOrder.prototype (patch: ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS listener, getOnlinePaymentUrl, filterPaymentMethods, shouldUpdateLastOrderChange)
PaymentPage.prototype (patch: startPayment online branch, kiosk QR vs mobile window.open)
PosStore.prototype (patch: cashier-side mobile bus listener -> printSelfOrderReceipt once)

external_integrations.pattern: No direct outbound HTTP in this module: it reuses pos_online_payment's portal + the payment engine's providers. The acquirer API calls / api-keys live in payment + payment_<provider>; this bridge contributes only the self-order routing, the bus feedback loop and the auto-receipt.
external_integrations.note: gap #7 uses_api_keys=true is indirect/inherited; this module adds no endpoint or SDK import of its own.

organization: (no new groups) reuses point_of_sale POS groups + the public/portal access of the pos_online_payment pay routes and pos_self_order's self_ordering_default_user_id

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_online_payment_self_order is a sell-flow bridge classified chain / primary / 3.0, inheriting the call of both parents (pos_online_payment is chain/primary/3.0; pos_self_order is the one network-flavoured outlier, but classed primary/3.0 as a customer order-capture channel). The mission this module completes is the SETTLEMENT of a retail self-order: it lets the diner pay the pos.order they just built on their phone/kiosk and then drives that confirmed transaction back into the live POS session as a real pos.payment + account.payment and finalises the order -- the Market-and-Sell 'tender and complete the sale' step (3.5 manage-sales-orders) realised on the customer's own device. It is primary because it is part of completing a revenue transaction (not a back-office utility) and chain because its value logic moves the order along the sell pipeline to paid/fulfilled, then fires the kitchen/prep hook (_send_order) and the receipt. It carries clear NETWORK overtones -- it mediates buyer + acquirer through public mediation routes (/pos/pay) and a real-time bus, much like pos_online_payment and the self-order channel it sits on -- but, exactly as the pos_online_payment record argues, the value it actually completes is the chain sell, with the buyer/acquirer brokering being the mechanism, so chain wins over network. APQC 9.0 (Manage Financial Resources) was considered because the confirmed tx does feed an account.payment (a 9.x collect-cash effect) and the trigger is a payment; rejected as the dominant concern because that accounting settlement is a triggered downstream consequence of finishing the POS sale -- the module exists to complete the self-order checkout, so its home is 3.0 Market and Sell, mirroring its payment-side parent rather than the account_payment engine.

standard_capabilities: online payment of a self-order/kiosk pos.order via the public /pos/pay portal (phone window.open or kiosk scan-to-pay QR)
one configurable self-order online payment method per mobile till; all online methods exposed in kiosk mode
automatic settlement of the confirmed transaction into an online pos.payment + account.payment and order finalisation (reused from pos_online_payment)
real-time progress/success/fail feedback to both the customer SPA and the cashier terminal over the ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS bus
auto-emailed self-order receipt (preset mail template) and once-only cashier-side prep/receipt auto-print on success
prompt async post-processing of self-order transactions (immediate cron trigger)
typical_fits: restaurant mobile QR table-ordering where the diner pays online from their phone
fast-food self-service kiosk presenting a scan-to-pay QR for an online provider
pay-each self-order flows that must settle and notify the kitchen the moment payment confirms
any provider already supported by an installed payment_<provider> module
common_gaps: ships no acquirer: a payment_<provider> module must be installed and a provider published/enabled, sharing the config currency
kiosk-terminal (in-person card reader) payment is pos_self_order's _payment_request_from_kiosk path, not this online-portal flow
the self-order online method is single per mobile config; multi-provider choice in mobile needs customisation
QR/redirect UX is the standard popup/QR; bespoke kiosk or table-QR presentation is OWL dev on pos_self_order.assets
no per-provider fee/reconciliation handling beyond what account_payment provides
drive_hints: curl GET /pos/pay/<pos_order_id>?access_token=...&exit_route=... (auth=public) to render the self-order pay form (and trigger the 'progress' bus push)
browse /pos-self/<config_id> (mobile), build an order, choose the online method -> the client opens /pos/pay and awaits ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS

Exact client reconciliation when the ONLINE_PAYMENT_STATUS bus message races the customer returning via /pos/pay/confirmation (which path marks the SPA confirmed first).
Behaviour of split payments (partial online + cashier) on a self-order, and how use_self_order_online_payment toggles via get_and_set_online_payments_data(0).

Whether the immediate payment.cron_post_process_payment_tx trigger in _process can double-settle if the confirmation route already ran _process_pos_online_payment (idempotency relies on tx.payment_id.pos_order_id guard).
Which payment_<provider> modules are installed and which require a logged-in customer (tokenization is force-disabled for public users on these routes).
